## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector breadth plus a major divergence across large caps (multiple big names with 1W positive vs 1M negative) supports a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +14.36%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing strong short-week movers but mixed monthly trends: AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +2.14%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate weak: DLR (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Utilities showing clear weakness: T (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -12.61%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -9.82%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -6.87% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5 SP100 performers: SCHW (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +16.20%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +10.55% | 1M: -0.93%) RECOVERY, IBM (1W: +10.27% | 1M: -2.00%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.09% | 1M: -3.55%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in Top 5), indicating cross-sector short-term strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Worst 5: DLR (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -12.61%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -9.82%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -10.20%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -10.18% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Real Estate and Communications.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: SCHW (1W: +10.97%), AAPL (1W: +10.18%), TSLA (1W: +10.55%), IBM (1W: +10.27%), META (1W: +9.09%) — all showing sizable weekly bursts. Major divergence flag: MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%), NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%), AMZN (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -2.34%) — multiple large caps in RECOVERY suggests tactical, not structural, conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/short-term bounce. AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +2.14%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) and MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) are RECOVERY, indicating intra-sector rotation and dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and broad. JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +14.36%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND point to durable financial leadership and earnings/flows support.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious but positive pockets. JNJ (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION show sector strength on the month with short-week pullbacks; PFE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -6.39%) BELOW TREND is a notable outlier despite bullish news.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor financials and selective cyclicals for exposure while reducing exposure to lagging REITs and telecoms; monitor tech rebound names for confirmation before adding exposure. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given simultaneous Financials ABOVE TREND and broad tech RECOVERY signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +16.20%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: DLR (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -12.61%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (part of the 6/11 positives) — JPM, V, MA ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Real Estate and Communication — DLR, AMT, T BELOW TREND and showing headline-driven downside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AAPL 1W momentum continuation: watch consolidation above recent range (AAPL (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND) for confirmation; NVDA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY needs follow-through above last-week highs to validate trend change; JPM (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND breakout persistence would confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+85): FDA approval headline; price PFE (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -6.39%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price diverging (distribution). SCHW (+60): stress-test and inflows; SCHW (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +16.20%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. DE (+60): guidance lift; BA (proxy cyclicals) BA (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-55): downgrade risk; INTU not listed in top details but flagged negative — watch for price pressure. MSFT (-45): Xbox cuts headline; MSFT (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -9.50%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines vs short-term bounce is a divergence to monitor. RCL (-50): booking concerns; RCL (1W: -9.54% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price both weakening.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Financials showing relative strength (JPM ABOVE TREND, V ABOVE TREND) while large-cap Tech shows short-week rebounds with many names in RECOVERY (NVDA, MSFT, META). Key risk: major divergence between bullish headlines (e.g., PFE +85) and price BELOW TREND, watch for follow-through before increasing exposure.
